title: Manager sync — prep & scratch (Emma Liu)
content:
Quick context: weekly 1:1 with Alex. Still onboarding onto rollout feature work, trying to balance infra debt + rollout polish. Keep this conversational; main ask = alignment on priorities and headcount ask timeline.

Agenda (30m):
- 5m: quick personal check-in (remind: parents visiting next week).
- 7m: blockers + ship risks: rollout E2E tests flaky on multi-region matrix (see RINF-2147), need ops support?
- 8m: priorities & tradeoffs: should I pause latency-cost optimization spikes to finish canary autoscale? tradeoffs: infra debt vs immediate customer need.
- 5m: career / growth note: ask about scope for IC3->IC4 stretch (mentoring + owning cross-team rollout).
- 5m: action items + next sync cadence.

Notes / talking points to hit:
- Blocker detail: E2E flakiness reproduces locally only sometimes; hypothesis: test infra parallelism + KV cache warm-up race. Tried narrowing to sequence-length 4–8 only and reduced flake by ~30%. Need dedicated test run on dedicated capacity pool (timeboxed).
- Customer impact: two customers reported higher A/B latency during canary (p50 +110ms). Not yet critical but visible on console.
- Proposed mitigation: temporary routing policy to fallback to variant-b when regional capacity < threshold. Implementation effort ~2 days + config entry. Want approval to prioritize.

Metrics to mention:
- Canary throughput: target 120 reqs/s, currently 92 reqs/s under synthetic harness.
- P50 latency regional: 230ms -> spike to 340ms during canary load.
- Cost note: current experiment increased unit cost ~6% due to smaller batches from routing policy.

Career ask script:
- "I want to take on a cross-team rollout owning design + runbook. I can mentor a junior (Ravi) for the follow-ups. What's the timeline and evidence you'd want to see for IC4?"

Feedback I want from Alex:
- Priority decision: finish canary autoscale polish vs addressing KV-test infra debt now.
- Headcount guidance: how fast can we hire a SRE/infra contractor?
- Risk tolerance for temporary route fallback (customer-visible change).

Draft action items (post-meeting):
- [ ] Get Alex approval to implement fallback routing policy (assign to me).
- [ ] Schedule a 2-hour dedicated test-run on Dedicated pool w/ QE and SRE (Ravi + Priya).
- [ ] Draft runbook for canary rollback + customer comms (deliverable by Mar 19).
- [ ] Set up weekly 30m sync with Priya for infra test stabilization (start next Thu).
- [ ] Share career growth plan and suggested stretch projects; ask for mentors list.

Notes to self: keep it short, concrete requests, avoid technical deep dives unless asked. If Alex pushes hiring talk, present cost/benefit: 2-week contractor vs 3-month hire.

Unresolved questions I want to log here:
- Is there an internal template for a temporary-routing policy change that has shipped before? (check infra runbooks)
- Who owns the customer comms at the moment for canary regressions? (CS vs eng)

End of prep. Will update after meeting with outcomes + timestamps.
